scope: Published on-demand prices and documented service geography, not an inventory guarantee. Catalog prices are not live region-specific deployment quotes.

offers.basis: Secure Cloud on-demand Pod catalog. Official AP-IN-1 announcement identifies India and deployment of H100 80GB HBM3 GPUs, with console steps for that GPU and region.

offers.basis: Fresh HTML from the USD pricing page lists one H100 SXM5 with 80 GB VRAM, 30 CPUs and 120 GB RAM at 3.81 USD/hour. The official locations documentation identifies FIN-01, FIN-02 and FIN-03 in Helsinki, Finland. The Verda team forum confirms H100 deployment in FIN-02.
offers.limit: The first price is on-demand and the second is spot. The older search-cached H100 landing page showed a different converted price; the fresh USD pricing-table value takes precedence.

offers.basis: Official one-GPU pricing table lists H100 SXM with 80 GB VRAM at 4.29 USD/GPU-hour. Official service documentation lists physical cloud locations in North America, Europe, Asia and the Middle East and explains that instance types vary by region.
offers.limit: No current public one-to-one mapping between this one-GPU SXM price and one specific country was established, so the card uses Global regions rather than inventing a country or using the headquarters address.
